name: Joel H. Defebaugh
occupation: Deputy county attorney and felony prosecutor in the Albany County and Prosecuting Attorney's Office (Laramie Boomerang, Nov. 7, 2026, and Laramie Reporter, Nov. 5, 2026)
prior_offices: Deputy county attorney, Albany County and Prosecuting Attorney's Office (identified as such in 2026 general-election coverage)
background: Joel H. Defebaugh of Albany County ran as a Republican in the November 2026 general election for Albany County and prosecuting attorney and lost to incumbent Edward Kurt Britzius. The Laramie Boomerang and Laramie Reporter identified him as a deputy county attorney and felony prosecutor in that office and reported that he received 6,005 votes (47.4%) to Britzius's 6,639 (52.4%).
